source.note: Satland Prototype (Warsaw). 'Zasady ogólne dla płytek PCB': standard rules for 35 µm copper, a second set for 70 and 105 µm, and 'Zasady dla zamówień specjalnych' (special orders, priced individually) as tier special. Multilayer boards are offered but no layer counts are given, so only 1 and 2 are listed. Read 2026-11-12 from the live pages by `eda-agent fab-refresh` on a Windows PC and transcribed by hand.
